zh-CN.name: 动态字体
zh-CN.description: 通过文字的位置、比例、节奏或出现顺序传递强调与叙事的动态排印。它描述文字的运动编排，不等于使用某种特殊字体或让所有正文一直移动。
use_when: 短标题或关键短语需要额外强调。
运动与文字内容有清楚关系。
avoid_when: 正文、表单标签和关键说明不应持续移动。
不能只在短暂动画的一帧展示必要内容。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 为短标题设计可读的文字入场或强调，完成后停在稳定排版；保留完整静态文本、阅读顺序和换行规则；减少动态效果时直接显示最终文字，不用视觉拆字破坏文本语义。

en.name: Kinetic Typography
en.description: Animated typography that communicates emphasis or narrative through position, scale, timing or reveal order. It describes choreographed text movement, not a special typeface or continuously moving body copy.
use_when: Short headings or key phrases benefit from added emphasis.
The motion has a clear relationship to the text.
avoid_when: Body copy, form labels and essential instructions should not keep moving.
Required information must not exist only for one brief animation frame.
en.prompt_template: Animate the entry or emphasis of short headings, then settle into a stable readable layout. Preserve complete static text, reading order and wrapping. Show final text immediately when motion is reduced, and avoid breaking text semantics for visual letter effects.
